description: Add a ticket tier to a live event you manage — free RSVP (price 0) or paid, with capacity and optional approval. secret: true hides the tier and returns an auto-generated unlock code (secretCode, SECRET_XXXX) guests enter as a promo code at checkout; for your own code, create_promo_code with applicable_classes [ticketTierId]. Paid tiers can be added before Stripe is connected (your share is held until you connect; a community-routed event sells only once its payouts are set up). Requires event_id; you must be a host.
name: add_ticket_tier
title: Add Ticket Tier
